note: The High cargo cache path into `deploy-rust` was judged overstated: the writers the path names are pull_request runs, whose cache lives under the pull request merge ref and is never restored by the release, so only a writer of the default branch reaches it, Medium at most. No job here declares cache-mode, so GitHub keeps the cache of every low-trust run read-only and grants no job cache write: ISSUE-705 is silent and no cache path exists, so the cache ceiling admits none.
